_comment: Caps on structural-debt signals under dblift/, consumed by scripts/check_debt_ratchet.py. Counts may stay flat or shrink, never grow. Freed headroom must not be reused: lower the cap in the same pull request that lowers the count.
_policy: Initial measurement on develop fdfe3be (2026-09-21); tightened on develop 1f2a12e after unreachable code was removed; tightened again after the post-commit table probe was removed from the migration engine. Comment-only lines are never counted. function_level_imports: package imports below module level. any_annotations: non-import lines using Any in a type. dynamic_attribute_access: lines calling getattr/hasattr. broad_excepts: 'except Exception' handlers. large_files: modules over 800 lines. process_references: lines naming an internal tracking identifier (epic/story numbers, ticket ids); held at 0. any_annotations raised by 1 for SqlGeneratorProtocol.generate_schema_script(options: Optional[Any]): its real type, ScriptOptions, lives in the generator package that dblift/db must not import, and object would make BaseSqlGenerator fail the Protocol.
